name: ZipRecruiter US
description: ZipRecruiter US job marketplace: job search by title and city/state (the public /Jobs/ directory pages, 20 cards a page with pay, employment and location types, benefits and posting time), full job postings (JobPosting JSON-LD plus the page's job details), a company's open jobs near a city, salary percentiles for a title in a city, and title/location autocomplete.

tools.name: Company jobs
tools.description: After search_jobs, with the company slug from a card's company_url (e.g. YO-AI-Labs from /co/YO-AI-Labs/Jobs) and a city.

options.name: company_slug
options.about: Company slug as it appears in /co/<slug>/Jobs, e.g. YO-AI-Labs. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._()'&,-]*$.

options.name: location
options.about: US city and two-letter state, "City, ST".

options.name: radius_miles
options.about: Search radius around the city in miles (site default 25).

response.about: Open jobs of one employer on ZipRecruiter near a US city, one page of up to 20 job cards from the public /co/<Company-Slug>/Jobs/-in-<City>,<ST> page (same card shape as search_jobs), with the site's total count for the company.

fields.name: benefits
fields.about: e.g. medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid_time_off (BENEFIT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). Empty when the card lists none.

fields.name: company_url
fields.about: Absolute company jobs URL (/co/<slug>/Jobs).

fields.name: employment_types
fields.about: e.g. full_time, part_time, contractor (EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased).

fields.name: is_new
fields.about: true when the card carries the site's NEW flag.

fields.name: jid
fields.about: Open seat id (16 hex chars); the jid= query parameter of the job detail URL. Stable across the listing's locations.

fields.name: listing_key
fields.about: ZipRecruiter listing key (22-char base64url), one per posting+location listing.

fields.name: location_types
fields.about: e.g. remote, in_person, hybrid (LOCATION_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased).

fields.name: pay
fields.about: Pay range as ZipRecruiter states it (parsed from the posting, provided by the employer, predicted or estimated); null when the page carries no visible pay.

fields.name: posted_at_utc
fields.about: RFC 3339 posting time as stated.

fields.name: short_description
fields.about: Card snippet with the site's <b> highlights removed and HTML entities decoded.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: RFC 3339 last update time as stated.

fields.name: url
fields.about: Absolute job detail URL (input for `job`).

tools.name: Job
tools.description: After search_jobs or company_jobs, with a card's url. Any pasted ziprecruiter.com /c/.../Job/... URL with a jid works.

response.about: One ZipRecruiter job posting from its detail page (/c/<Company>/Job/<Title>/-in-<City>,<ST>?jid=...): title, employer (name, ids, website, size, HQ, industries), location, pay range, employment/location types, benefits, active flag, posting and expiry dates, O*NET occupational category, full HTML description and apply routing, combining the page's JobPosting JSON-LD with its job details payload.

fields.name: location_type
fields.about: JSON-LD jobLocationType, e.g. TELECOMMUTE; null when the posting is on-site.

fields.name: occupational_category
fields.about: O*NET-SOC code and name as stated, e.g. "15-1133.00: Software Developers, Systems Software".

fields.name: pay
fields.about: Pay range as ZipRecruiter states it (parsed from the posting, provided by the employer, predicted or estimated); null when the page carries no visible pay.

fields.name: url

fields.name: valid_through

response.description_html:
Full-Stack Software Engineer

Location: Global, Fully Remote
Job Type: Contractor | ~15 hours/week
Schedule: Flexible

We're looking for experienced Full-Stack Software Engineers to support an AI training project focused on software development, debugging, code evaluation, and technical problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and debug front-end and back-end applications.
  • Build features, APIs, services, and data models.
  • Understand and work across unfamiliar codebases.
  • Troubleshoot application, API, database, and integration issues.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Translate and adapt software builds between programming languages.
Required Skills
  • Python
  • React
  • JavaScript
  • Java
  • Node.js
  • Rust
  • Go
  • TypeScript
  • Strong full-stack development experience
  • Experience with APIs, databases, application architecture, and debugging
Hiring Process
  1. Submit application and screening questions.
  2. Complete a ~30-minute AI interview.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Hiring manager review.
response.title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer - Remote

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Start here to find job detail URLs and company slugs; pass page=next_page to continue. Only title and city/state are filterable: pay, distance and date filters live behind ZipRecruiter's challenged interactive search and are not exposed.

options.name: location

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page number; 20 cards per page. Use next_page from the previous call.

options.name: title
options.about: Job title words, e.g. "software engineer" or "Registered Nurse". Slugified to ZipRecruiter's Title-Case-Hyphenated directory form.
